passages.text: Then we turned back and headed for the wilderness by way of the Red Sea, as the LORD had instructed me, and for many days we wandered around Mount Seir.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me instructions.
We obeyed the LORD.
We turned back.
We traveled toward the wilderness.
We went by way of the Red Sea.
We wandered around Mount Seir.
We stayed there for many days.
passages.original: וַנֵּ֜פֶן וַנִּסַּ֤ע הַמִּדְבָּ֙רָה֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יַם־ ס֔וּף כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י וַנָּ֥סָב אֶת־ הַר־ שֵׂעִ֖יר יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃ס

passages.text: At this time the LORD said to me, “You have been wandering around this hill country long enough; turn to the north and command the people: ‘You will pass through the territory of your brothers, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, so you must be very careful.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me a command.
He said, “You have wandered around this mountain long enough.
Turn north.
Give the people this command.
You will pass through the land of your brothers.
Your brothers are the descendants of Esau.
They live in Seir.
They will be afraid of you.
Be very careful.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ רַב־ לָכֶ֕ם סֹ֖ב אֶת־ הָהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה פְּנ֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם צָפֹֽנָה׃ וְאֶת־ הָעָם֮ צַ֣ו לֵאמֹר֒ אַתֶּ֣ם עֹֽבְרִ֗ים בִּגְבוּל֙ אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם בְּנֵי־ עֵשָׂ֔ו הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּשֵׂעִ֑יר וְיִֽירְא֣וּ מִכֶּ֔ם וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: Do not provoke them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even a footprint, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as his possession.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave a command to the Israelites.
God said, “Do not provoke the descendants of Esau.
They live in Seir.
I will not give you any of their land.
You will not receive even a footprint of their territory.
I have given Mount Seir to Esau.
Mount Seir belongs to Esau as his possession.”
passages.original: אַל־ תִּתְגָּר֣וּ בָ֔ם כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּ֤ן לָכֶם֙ מֵֽאַרְצָ֔ם עַ֖ד מִדְרַ֣ךְ כַּף־ רָ֑גֶל כִּֽי־ יְרֻשָּׁ֣ה לְעֵשָׂ֔ו נָתַ֖תִּי אֶת־ הַ֥ר שֵׂעִֽיר׃

passages.text: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and the water you drink.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
The Israelites would pass through the land of the descendants of Esau.
The descendants of Esau lived in Seir.
God told the Israelites to buy food from the people of Seir.
The Israelites must pay with silver for the food.
The Israelites would eat the food they bought.
God told the Israelites to buy water from the people of Seir.
The Israelites must pay with silver for the water.
The Israelites would drink the water they bought.
passages.original: אֹ֣כֶל תִּשְׁבְּר֧וּ מֵֽאִתָּ֛ם בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֑ם וְגַם־ מַ֜יִם תִּכְר֧וּ מֵאִתָּ֛ם בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וּשְׁתִיתֶֽם׃

passages.text: Indeed, the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has watched over your journey through this vast wilderness. The LORD your God has been with you these forty years, and you have lacked nothing.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD has blessed you.
He has blessed all the work of your hands.
He has watched over your journey.
You traveled through this great and vast wilderness.
The LORD your God has been with you for forty years.
You have lacked nothing.
passages.original: כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ בֵּֽרַכְךָ֗ בְּכֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֔ךָ יָדַ֣ע לֶכְתְּךָ֔ אֶת־ הַמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַגָּדֹ֖ל הַזֶּ֑ה זֶ֣ה׀ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א חָסַ֖רְתָּ דָּבָֽר׃

passages.text: So we passed by our brothers, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. We turned away from the Arabah road, which comes up from Elath and Ezion-geber, and traveled along the road of the Wilderness of Moab.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled together as a group.
The Israelites passed by their brothers.
These brothers were the descendants of Esau.
The descendants of Esau lived in Seir.
The Israelites did not take the Arabah road.
The Arabah road comes up from Elath and Ezion-geber.
The Israelites turned away from that road.
The Israelites traveled along the road of the Wilderness of Moab.
passages.original: וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֞ר מֵאֵ֧ת אַחֵ֣ינוּ בְנֵי־ עֵשָׂ֗ו הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֵׂעִ֔יר מִדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ הָֽעֲרָבָ֔ה מֵאֵילַ֖ת וּמֵעֶצְיֹ֣ן גָּ֑בֶרס וַנֵּ֙פֶן֙ וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֔ר דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר מוֹאָֽב׃

passages.text: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, because I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as their possession.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He is the God of Israel.
He said, “Do not harass the Moabites.
Do not provoke the Moabites to war.
I will not give you any of their land.
I have given the land of Ar to the descendants of Lot.
That land belongs to them as their possession.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֶל־ תָּ֙צַר֙ אֶת־ מוֹאָ֔ב וְאַל־ תִּתְגָּ֥ר בָּ֖ם מִלְחָמָ֑ה כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּ֨ן לְךָ֤ מֵֽאַרְצוֹ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֣י לִבְנֵי־ ל֔וֹט נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־ עָ֖ר יְרֻשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: (The Emites used to live there, a people great and many, as tall as the Anakites.
passages.sermon:
The Emites lived there in the past.
The Emites were a people.
They were great in number.
They were many.
They were tall.
They were as tall as the Anakites.
passages.original: הָאֵמִ֥ים לְפָנִ֖ים יָ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֑הּ עַ֣ם גָּד֥וֹל וְרַ֛ב וָרָ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִֽים׃

passages.text: Like the Anakites, they were also regarded as Rephaim, though the Moabites called them Emites.
passages.sermon:
The people called Emites lived in the land before the Moabites.
The Emites were very large and strong.
People thought the Emites were like the Anakites.
People also called the Emites by another name.
People regarded the Emites as Rephaim.
The Moabites called these people Emites.
passages.original: רְפָאִ֛ים יֵחָשְׁב֥וּ אַף־ הֵ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִ֑ים וְהַמֹּ֣אָבִ֔ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם אֵמִֽים׃

passages.text: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the descendants of Esau drove them out. They destroyed the Horites from before them and settled in their place, just as Israel did in the land that the LORD gave them as their possession.)
passages.sermon:
The Horites lived in Seir long ago.
The descendants of Esau came to Seir.
The descendants of Esau drove out the Horites.
The descendants of Esau destroyed the Horites.
The descendants of Esau took the place of the Horites.
Israel did something similar.
Israel took the land that the LORD gave them.
Israel settled in that land as their possession.
passages.original: וּבְשֵׂעִ֞יר יָשְׁב֣וּ הַחֹרִים֮ לְפָנִים֒ וּבְנֵ֧י עֵשָׂ֣ו יִֽירָשׁ֗וּם וַיַּשְׁמִידוּם֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ תַּחְתָּ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר עָשָׂ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְאֶ֙רֶץ֙ יְרֻשָּׁת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: “Now arise and cross over the Brook of Zered.” So we crossed over the Brook of Zered.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
God commanded them to act.
God said, “Now arise.
Cross over the Brook of Zered.”
The Israelites obeyed God.
They crossed over the Brook of Zered.
passages.original: עַתָּ֗ה קֻ֛מוּ וְעִבְר֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַ֣חַל זָ֑רֶד וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־ נַ֥חַל זָֽרֶד׃

passages.text: The time we spent traveling from Kadesh-barnea until we crossed over the Brook of Zered was thirty-eight years, until that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the LORD had sworn to them.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled from Kadesh-barnea to the Brook of Zered.
This journey took thirty-eight years.
During this time, all the fighting men from that generation died.
They died within the camp.
The LORD had sworn that this would happen.
The LORD kept His promise.
passages.original: וְהַיָּמִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־ הָלַ֣כְנוּ׀ מִקָּדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֗עַ עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר־ עָבַ֙רְנוּ֙ אֶת־ נַ֣חַל זֶ֔רֶד שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה עַד־ תֹּ֨ם כָּל־ הַדּ֜וֹר אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ מִקֶּ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Indeed, the LORD’s hand was against them, to eliminate them from the camp, until they had all perished.
passages.sermon: The LORD acted against them.\r\nHe removed them from the camp.\r\nHe continued until all of them had died.
passages.original: וְגַ֤ם יַד־ יְהוָה֙ הָ֣יְתָה בָּ֔ם לְהֻמָּ֖ם מִקֶּ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃

passages.text: Now when all the fighting men among the people had died, the LORD said to me, “Today you are going to cross the border of Moab at Ar.
passages.sermon:
Moses led the people of Israel in the wilderness.
All the fighting men among the people died.
This happened just as the LORD had said.
After they died, the LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said, “Today you will cross the border of Moab at Ar.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֨י כַאֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֜מּוּ כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֧י הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה לָמ֖וּת מִקֶּ֥רֶב הָעָֽם׃ס וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ אַתָּ֨ה עֹבֵ֥ר הַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־ גְּב֥וּל מוֹאָ֖ב אֶת־ עָֽר׃

passages.text: But when you get close to the Ammonites, do not harass them or provoke them, for I will not give you any of the land of the Ammonites. I have given it to the descendants of Lot as their possession.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses a command about the Ammonites.
The Ammonites are descendants of Lot.
When you come near the land of the Ammonites, do not attack them.
Do not start a fight with them.
God will not give you any of the land of the Ammonites.
God has given that land to the descendants of Lot.
The descendants of Lot will keep that land as their possession.
passages.original: וְקָרַבְתָּ֗ מ֚וּל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן אַל־ תְּצֻרֵ֖ם וְאַל־ תִּתְגָּ֣ר בָּ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹֽא־ אֶ֠תֵּן מֵאֶ֨רֶץ בְּנֵי־ עַמּ֤וֹן לְךָ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י לִבְנֵי־ ל֖וֹט נְתַתִּ֥יהָ יְרֻשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: (That too was regarded as the land of the Rephaim, who used to live there, though the Ammonites called them Zamzummites.
passages.sermon:
The land was called the land of the Rephaim.
The Rephaim were a group of ancient people.
They used to live in that land.
The Ammonites lived nearby.
The Ammonites called the Rephaim by another name.
The Ammonites called them Zamzummites.
passages.original: אֶֽרֶץ־ רְפָאִ֥ים תֵּחָשֵׁ֖ב אַף־ הִ֑וא רְפָאִ֤ים יָֽשְׁבוּ־ בָהּ֙ לְפָנִ֔ים וְהָֽעַמֹּנִ֔ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם זַמְזֻמִּֽים׃

passages.text: They were a people great and many, as tall as the Anakites. But the LORD destroyed them from before the Ammonites, who drove them out and settled in their place, just as He had done for the descendants of Esau who lived in Seir, when He destroyed the Horites from before them. They drove them out and have lived in their place to this day.
passages.sermon:
The Rephaim were a people.
They were great in number.
They were very tall.
They were as tall as the Anakites.
The LORD destroyed the Rephaim before the Ammonites.
The Ammonites drove out the Rephaim.
The Ammonites settled in the land of the Rephaim.
The LORD did the same for the descendants of Esau.
The descendants of Esau lived in Seir.
The LORD destroyed the Horites before the descendants of Esau.
The descendants of Esau drove out the Horites.
The descendants of Esau settled in the land of the Horites.
They have lived there until this day.
passages.original: עַ֣ם גָּד֥וֹל וְרַ֛ב וָרָ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִ֑ים וַיַּשְׁמִידֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּירָשֻׁ֖ם וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽם׃ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּשֵׂעִ֑יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִשְׁמִ֤יד אֶת־ הַחֹרִי֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּֽירָשֻׁם֙ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ תַחְתָּ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: And the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, were destroyed by the Caphtorites, who came out of Caphtor and settled in their place.)
passages.sermon:
The Avvim were a people.
They lived in villages.
Their villages reached as far as Gaza.
The Caphtorites came out of Caphtor.
The Caphtorites destroyed the Avvim.
The Caphtorites settled in the land of the Avvim.
passages.original: וְהָֽעַוִּ֛ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בַּחֲצֵרִ֖ים עַד־ עַזָּ֑ה כַּפְתֹּרִים֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים מִכַּפְתּ֔וֹר הִשְׁמִידֻ֖ם וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽם׃

passages.text: “Arise, set out, and cross the Arnon Valley. See, I have delivered into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
God commanded them to act.
He said, "Get up now.
Set out on your journey.
Cross the Arnon Valley.
Look, I have given Sihon into your hand.
Sihon is the king of Heshbon.
He is an Amorite.
I have also given you his land.
Begin to take possession of the land.
Start a battle with Sihon."
passages.original: ק֣וּמוּ סְּע֗וּ וְעִבְרוּ֮ אֶת־ נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹן֒ רְאֵ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּי בְ֠יָדְךָ אֶת־ סִיחֹ֨ן מֶֽלֶךְ־ חֶשְׁבּ֧וֹן הָֽאֱמֹרִ֛י וְאֶת־ אַרְצ֖וֹ הָחֵ֣ל רָ֑שׁ וְהִתְגָּ֥ר בּ֖וֹ מִלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: This very day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you upon all the nations under heaven. They will hear the reports of you and tremble in anguish because of you.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
God said He would act today.
God would make all nations under heaven fear the Israelites.
God would cause dread of the Israelites to fall on every nation.
All these nations would hear about the Israelites.
They would tremble when they heard about the Israelites.
They would feel anguish because of the Israelites.
passages.original: הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ תֵּ֤ת פַּחְדְּךָ֙ וְיִרְאָ֣תְךָ֔ עַל־ פְּנֵי֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כָּל־ הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁמְעוּן֙ שִׁמְעֲךָ֔ וְרָגְז֥וּ וְחָל֖וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: So from the Wilderness of Kedemoth I sent messengers with an offer of peace to Sihon king of Heshbon, saying, “Let us pass through your land; we will stay on the main road. We will not turn to the right or to the left.
passages.sermon:
Moses led the Israelites in the wilderness.
I sent messengers from the Wilderness of Kedemoth.
I sent them to Sihon.
Sihon was king of Heshbon.
I sent a message of peace to Sihon.
I said, “Let us pass through your land.
We will walk on the main road.
We will not turn to the right.
We will not turn to the left.”
passages.original: וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכִים֙ מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר קְדֵמ֔וֹת אֶל־ סִיח֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן דִּבְרֵ֥י שָׁל֖וֹם לֵאמֹֽר׃ אֶעְבְּרָ֣ה בְאַרְצֶ֔ךָ בַּדֶּ֥רֶךְ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֵלֵ֑ךְ לֹ֥א אָס֖וּר יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃

passages.text: You can sell us food to eat and water to drink in exchange for silver. Only let us pass through on foot, just as the descendants of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for us, until we cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD our God is giving us.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites spoke to Sihon, king of Heshbon.
They asked for permission to pass through his land.
They said, “You can sell us food.
We will eat the food you sell us.
You can give us water for silver.
We will drink the water you give us.
We will only pass through your land on foot.
We will not stay or turn aside.
The descendants of Esau live in Seir.
The Moabites live in Ar.
They let us pass through their lands.
We ask to pass through your land the same way.
We will do this until we cross the Jordan River.
The LORD our God is giving us a land across the Jordan.
We will go there as God has promised us.”
passages.original: אֹ֣כֶל בַּכֶּ֤סֶף תַּשְׁבִּרֵ֙נִי֙ וְאָכַ֔לְתִּי וּמַ֛יִם בַּכֶּ֥סֶף תִּתֶּן־ לִ֖י וְשָׁתִ֑יתִי רַ֖ק אֶעְבְּרָ֥ה בְרַגְלָֽי׃ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָֽשׂוּ־ לִ֜י בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֵׂעִ֔יר וְהַמּ֣וֹאָבִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּעָ֑ר עַ֤ד אֲשֶֽׁר־ אֶֽעֱבֹר֙ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass through, for the LORD your God had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate, that He might deliver him into your hand, as is the case this day.
passages.sermon:
Sihon was the king of Heshbon.
He would not let us pass through his land.
The LORD your God made Sihon's spirit stubborn.
The LORD made Sihon's heart strong and unyielding.
The LORD did this so He could give Sihon into your hand.
This happened just as you see today.
passages.original: וְלֹ֣א אָבָ֗ה סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן הַעֲבִרֵ֖נוּ בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ הִקְשָׁה֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת־ רוּח֗וֹ וְאִמֵּץ֙ אֶת־ לְבָב֔וֹ לְמַ֛עַן תִּתּ֥וֹ בְיָדְךָ֖ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס

passages.text: Then the LORD said to me, “See, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his land over to you. Now begin to conquer and possess his land.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He said, "Look."
"I have started to give Sihon to you."
I have also started to give his land to you.
Begin to take his land.
Start to possess his land."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י רְאֵ֗ה הַֽחִלֹּ֙תִי֙ תֵּ֣ת לְפָנֶ֔יךָ אֶת־ סִיחֹ֖ן וְאֶת־ אַרְצ֑וֹ הָחֵ֣ל רָ֔שׁ לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־ אַרְצֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So Sihon and his whole army came out for battle against us at Jahaz.
passages.sermon:
Sihon was the king of Heshbon.
Sihon gathered his whole army.
Sihon and his army came out to fight us.
They met us at Jahaz.
They prepared for battle against us.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵא֩ סִיחֹ֨ן לִקְרָאתֵ֜נוּ ה֧וּא וְכָל־ עַמּ֛וֹ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה יָֽהְצָה׃

passages.text: And the LORD our God delivered him over to us, and we defeated him and his sons and his whole army.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
The LORD gave Sihon to us.
We defeated Sihon.
We defeated Sihon's sons.
We defeated all of Sihon's army.
passages.original: וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֛הוּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְפָנֵ֑ינוּ וַנַּ֥ךְ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: At that time we captured all his cities and devoted to destruction the people of every city, including women and children. We left no survivors.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites fought Sihon and his people at Jahaz.
The LORD, who is our God, gave us victory over them.
At that time, we captured all the cities that belonged to Sihon.
We destroyed every person in every city.
We killed the men.
We killed the women.
We killed the children.
We did not leave any survivors.
passages.original: וַנִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת־ כָּל־ עָרָיו֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַֽנַּחֲרֵם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ עִ֣יר מְתִ֔ם וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּ֑ף לֹ֥א הִשְׁאַ֖רְנוּ שָׂרִֽיד׃

passages.text: We carried off for ourselves only the livestock and the plunder from the cities we captured.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites fought against their enemies.
The LORD, who is their God, gave them victory.
The Israelites captured many cities.
They took the livestock for themselves.
They took the plunder from the cities they captured.
They did not keep anything else for themselves.
passages.original: רַ֥ק הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה בָּזַ֣זְנוּ לָ֑נוּ וּשְׁלַ֥ל הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכָֽדְנוּ׃

passages.text: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the valley, even as far as Gilead, not one city had walls too high for us. The LORD our God gave us all of them.
passages.sermon:
Israel was the subject.
Israel was conquering cities.
Aroer was on the edge of the Arnon Valley.
There was a city in the valley.
Gilead was farther away.
Israel captured every city from Aroer to Gilead.
No city had walls too strong for Israel.
The LORD our God gave every city to Israel.
passages.original: מֵֽעֲרֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־ שְׂפַת־ נַ֨חַל אַרְנֹ֜ן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּנַּ֙חַל֙ וְעַד־ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לֹ֤א הָֽיְתָה֙ קִרְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂגְבָ֖ה מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־ הַכֹּ֕ל נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְפָנֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: But you did not go near the land of the Ammonites, or the land along the banks of the Jabbok River, or the cities of the hill country, or any place that the LORD our God had forbidden.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites did not go near the land of the Ammonites.
They did not approach the land along the banks of the Jabbok River.
They did not go to the cities in the hill country.
They did not enter any place that the LORD their God had forbidden.
passages.original: רַ֛ק אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ בְּנֵי־ עַמּ֖וֹן לֹ֣א קָרָ֑בְתָּ כָּל־ יַ֞ד נַ֤חַל יַבֹּק֙ וְעָרֵ֣י הָהָ֔ר וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
